description: Recommend the best PuraSIM eSIM plan(s) for a trip, from its length in days and the expected data usage (light, medium or heavy). Accepts one destination or a list of countries visited on the same trip (it then looks for plans that cover all of them).

countries.description: Countries visited on one trip, e.g. ["France", "Italy", "Switzerland"]. Use instead of destination for multi-country trips.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Checkout may show the shopper's local currency.

destination.description: Country name in any language (e.g. "Japan", "Japón"), ISO 3166 code (e.g. "JP"), region (e.g. "Europe", "Asia", "Balkans", "Global") or a destinationId returned by another tool.

locale.description: Language of the user. Sets the language of the purasim.com pages returned (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, nl, pl, cs, da, no, sv, ro, tr, ar, he, id, ja, ko, th, zh) and of country names.

usage.description: light: maps, messaging, email. medium: social media, browsing, some video. heavy: video streaming, video calls, hotspot.

name: recommend_plan
title: Recommend an eSIM plan for a trip
